time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0
description: Straight-down aerial view of a long bridge/highway over water. Road runs vertically (tilted ~0.4 deg: x decreases ~7 px per 1000 px down). Left carriageway (x~690-1040) traffic moves DOWN the image; right carriageway (x~1080-1400) traffic moves UP. Four vehicles, all moving the whole clip at roughly constant pixel rates. Water both sides.

frame_duplication.note: The 59.35 fps file repeats frames in a 7-frame pattern (3 of every 7 frames are copies of the previous one; effective ~33.9 distinct images/s). One-frame differences alternate 0 and ~1.75x the true per-frame motion; use differences over several frames (or only unique frames) for rates. See tracks/frame_duplicates.csv.

camera.motion: static (no pan/zoom): lamp heads move <=2 px over the clip, top-bottom lamp separation constant within 0.5 px; phase-correlation drift of bridge strips <=1.1 px (tracks/camera_shift.csv). No background compensation needed.
camera.view: nadir (looking straight down); no horizon; road plane fills frame
camera.scale_variation: Lane-dash period (true constant spacing) is 392-397 px near image centre (y~1800-2200) and 403-406 px near top and bottom (y~200, ~3400): local vertical px scale varies ~+-1.7% (lens distortion), symmetric about the image centre. Car lengths follow it (white_car_lower 105.7->108.9 px moving from y 2620 to 3166). The benchmark convention is a single scale; this is just a caveat.

white_car_upper.description: white sedan, left (southbound/downward) carriageway, inner lane x~868; starts upper-middle of frame (y~1462 at f0)
white_car_upper.ref_point: centre of the physical body box (shadow excluded)
white_car_upper.size_note: L from half-max edges at f0/54/107: 121.3/121/121.3; per-frame edge_length 119.8-121.5

white_car_lower.description: smaller white hatchback/sedan, left carriageway, lane x~829 (left of white_car_upper's lane); starts y~2620 at f0
white_car_lower.ref_point: centre of the physical body box (shadow excluded)
white_car_lower.size_note: L grows 105.7 (y~2620) -> 108.9 (y~3166) with image position (lens/scale variation, see static)

dark_car.description: dark grey/black SUV, right carriageway, lane x~1200 (left of the truck); starts beside truck cab (y~3160 at f0)
dark_car.motion: moves up the image (-y), overtakes the truck
dark_car.ref_point: centre of the physical body box (shadow excluded)
dark_car.size_note: L shrinks 131 (y~3160) -> 123 (y~2175); dark body + shadow make ends uncertain +-3 px

truck.description: semi-trailer truck: yellow cab + long white box trailer, right carriageway, rightmost lane x~1321
truck.occlusion: thin overhead lamp arm (y~2977) crosses the trailer during frames 19-90 (flag in csv); negligible for tracking
truck.ref_point: centre of the physical body box (shadow excluded)
truck.size_note: cab front bumper to trailer rear at f107 (truck centre y~2653); half-max width 72.7, outer incl. mirrors/edge ~77. per-frame edge length unreliable (front edge alternates between bumper and windshield)

lane_dashes.description: white dashed lane lines; length 159-170 px (median ~163; ~161 near centre, ~168 near top/bottom), period (dash start to next dash start) mean 400 px (392-406), gap ~237 px, width ~6-7 px

static_objects.lane_width_px: centre-to-centre of adjacent lane lines ~96-98 px (e.g. 859->956, 1196->1292 at top). Each carriageway: 3 lanes between solid edge lines.
static_objects.solid_lines: left carriageway outer edge line x~688-708 (near left railing); median edge lines x~1033 and x~1082 (median/barrier strip between ~1036 and ~1080); right carriageway outer edge line x~1372-1377 / railing ~1421-1473

lamp_posts.description: street lamps on both railings with arms over the outer lanes; heads (bright ~25x9 px) at y spacing ~711 px

static_objects.bridge_deck: deck incl. railings spans x~600-1530 (~930 px); water (dark teal) x<600 and x>1530

events.event: dark_car front level with truck front
dark_car centre level with truck front
white_car_lower and dark_car centres level in y (pass each other, opposite directions)
dark_car rear bumper level with truck front (dark car fully ahead of truck)
white_car_lower and truck centres level in y (pass each other, opposite directions)
all four vehicles in motion for the entire clip (no start/stop, no lane change)
